newsitem.title: USA: CME live cattle mixed on rolling, profit taking.
newsitem.headline: CME live cattle mixed on rolling, profit taking.

text.p: Rolling of long April positions into back months and continued profit taking kept nearby CME live cattle futures under pressure at the close while back months ended mixed, traders said.
Live cattle closed 0.450 cent per lb lower to 0.125 higher with April off most at 69.625 cents. Feeder cattle ended up 0.625 to 0.150 with March up most at 68.950 cents.
Rolling off long April positions into June and August by commercials and funds added to end of the month profit taking to pressure April despite ideas of continued strong cash, traders said.

Heavy-weight choice boxed beef rose $1.30 per cwt to $106.08 per cwt Thursday, highest level since December 31, and packers are expected to pay up to $72 per cwt for fed cattle next week. This prompted underlying support and accounted for the run up to contract highs earlier in the week, they said.
But not all traders were bullish on cash markets next week, especially after the sharp rise in beef prices.
"I think we are going to top out the beef and continue to see the retailer move over into the pork complex," said Dave Maher, livestock analyst for Securities Corporation of Iowa.
ADM Investor Services, R.J. O'Brien and Dean Witter sold April while Refco, Prudential Securities and Fimat Futures USA bought June, pit sources said.
In live cattle options, commission house liquidated by selling April 70 calls and buying June 70 calls. Volatility was steady to weak across the board, pit sources added.

Feeder cattle futures found short covering support after being technically oversold Thursday with mixed deferred live cattle futures and higher corn futures adding to buying interest early. Although corn rose late, feeders held firm on late scattered buy orders, traders said.

Refco bought March while Cargill Investor Services spread long August live cattle/short March feeders. Cargill was also actively spreading long December live cattle/short August feeders and long October live cattle/short May feeders, pit sources said
The latest CME feeder cattle index was off $0.05 at $69.05 per cwt.
